messages:
liam: FYI CI flagged large regen diffs after the OpenAPI header-casing normalization in PR #4732. A bunch of SDK snapshots changed because some headers went from 'X-Request-Id' -> 'x-request-id' in the schema.

sam: Which SDKs are failing?

liam: JS + Python + dotnet show client surface diffs. devx-ci output clipped: 

```
devx-ci: packages/js-sdk client/src/apis/requests.ts (changed headers ordering)
1 file would be changed
error Command failed with exit code 1.
```

zoe: That's annoying. Is that an API contract change or tooling noise?

liam: Tooling noise: backend API didn't change semantics, just canonicalizing header names. But typegen emits different order and case for header constants, causing snapshot churn.

sam: Can we avoid a minor semver by fixing typegen to normalize header casing + stable key ordering?

liam: Plan: patch typegen to lowercase header keys and stable-sort header lists, then regen snapshots. Small changelog entry: "fix(typegen): normalize header casing to avoid spurious client diffs"

tariq: Also callout: onboarding docs reference header examples with Title-Case. We should add note that header canonicalization may require re-run of regen for local SDKs.

devx-ci: automated note: regen-check pipeline failed on commit d4e5f6. See https://ci.internal/jobs/regen-check/4732

zoe: For implementation, please ensure arrays of headers preserve the original declared order when semantically required (some middleware relies on first-value precedence). We don't want to reorder semantically significant arrays.

liam: Good point. We'll only stable-sort where order is unspecified (object keys), and preserve arrays like header lists. Add tests.

sam: Semver decision: if we only change generated code and no runtime behavior, patch release is okay. But product needs explicit QA on the sample-apps to validate nothing broke in auth/retry flows.

liam: I'll open a hotfix PR with tests + regen + changelog. Will run full smoke matrix against sample apps. Tentative PR title: "typegen: normalize header casing + deterministic key order"

release-bot: comment: issue #4781 created to add header-casing regression tests and regen-check to CI.

liam: Repro steps for reviewers:
1) checkout branch liam/header-normalize
2) yarn install
3) yarn workspace typegen build && yarn workspace typegen test
4) yarn regen --check packages/*/openapi.json
5) run sample-app smoke: yarn test:smoke across js/python/dotnet

zoe: I'll validate dotnet and python snapshots after regen. Ping me when PR is up.

liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/107  includes lowercase header normalization, stable-sort keys, and regen. Running samples now.

sam: If all sample apps pass, publish patch 1.3.2 with changelog line and an entry in the release notes clarifying this was a dev-tooling fix.

tariq: Add a short blurb to "onboarding/tools.md": "If your SDK snapshots changed after a tooling update, run yarn regen and validate sample-apps". Keeps new users from thinking API changed.

liam: Will do. Updating PR with docs change. Updating thread when CI completes.
